name: Take-Two Interactive

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org - Wikipedia infobox logo file: Take-Two Interactive Logo.svg

description: Take-Two makes and publishes video games under three labels: Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption), 2K (NBA 2K, Borderlands, WWE 2K, Civilization, Mafia) and Zynga (free-to-play mobile games, bought 2022). About 78 percent of revenue is recurrent consumer spending (virtual currency, add-on content and in-game purchases and ads on games already sold), and the rest is sales of new full games. Half of revenue comes from mobile, 39 percent from console. It depends on a few hits: Grand Theft Auto was 12.4 percent of fiscal 2026 revenue and the five biggest franchises were 54.3 percent. Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI will release on 2026-11-19.

businessLines.name: Recurrent consumer spending
businessLines.how: Players of GTA Online, NBA 2K and free-to-play mobile games keep spending on virtual currency and items after the initial sale; advertising in mobile games adds a separate stream.
businessLines.description: Virtual currency, add-on content, in-game purchases and in-game advertising from games players already own or play free.

businessLines.name: Full game and other
businessLines.how: One-time purchase per copy of a new game (physical or digital), concentrated in launch windows such as Borderlands 4 and the upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI.
businessLines.description: Initial sales of full game software and related services.
